topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 86 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 14 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs, 2 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 23 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, ownableupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
